faq.title: Frequently asked questions about PanelForge.
faq.subtitle: Common questions about team roles, studio workflows, and manuscript data storage during production.
faq.supportDesc: Building a production pipeline for a larger team? Administrators can configure role permissions and audit trails tailored to each series.
faq.a1: PanelForge is built for comic creation teams, studios, and independent creator groups—including writers, artists, editors, and project leads. Clear role-based permissions keep collaboration organized.
faq.q2: Can a new account create its own studio?
faq.a2: Yes. After signing up, you can create your own production studio right away or join another team's studio via an email invitation from an administrator.
faq.q3: Where does AI assist the team?
faq.a3: AI acts as a script and scene review assistant, cross-checking script details against your Series Bible (character traits, outfits, world rules) to remind the team to maintain consistency.
faq.a4: Every script update or new artwork submission is recorded as a distinct milestone with timestamp and contributor. Teams can review submission history to compare changes and track page progress.

cta.subtitle: Bring your team, scripts, and workflow into PanelForge. Turn fragmented days of work into a structured, reliable creative cycle.
